goal: Evaluate, visualize, and publish succeeded ACP job pt-9ohso8nd: direct_joints with active/right heads enabled and n_max=1 on cam836.

tasks_completed.summary: Recovered pt-9ohso8nd ACP/job settings, final.pt, history.json, and train loss evidence.
Ran train3 and test3 eval as ACP jobs pt-jvnxzz62 and pt-mgx9n3ef with final.pt, clip_len=13, n_max=1, camera0 r4 GT cache, and repaired cam836 subset manifests.
Generated RGB overlays and 3D videos for train3, a good matched test window, and a high-error test window; encoded H.264 mp4s locally and synced them to the remote eval artifact directory.

discoveries.title: active/right plus n_max=1 fixes matching
discoveries.body: Unlike pt-ymuns2jx, this run detects and matches every train3/test3 window: detection precision/recall/F1 are all 1.0 on both subsets.

discoveries.title: geometry remains far from target
discoveries.body: Direct 3D joint error is 233.2 mm on train3 and 159.9 mm on test3, so this is not a geometry solution.

discoveries.title: side classifier collapsed
discoveries.body: is_right logits are almost constant near 0.498 probability, effectively predicting left for every window; side accuracy is only 5/13 train and 5/14 test.

tasks_pending.summary: Do not treat this as accepted DT10 geometry: matching improved, but direct joint error remains O(160mm) on test3 and side classification collapsed.
Use this as evidence that active/right supervision fixes detection/matching but not spatially accurate hand geometry; next design must address global/local hand localization quality.

caveats: This is deterministic train3/test3 subset eval, not full 1000-entry cam836 eval.
direct_joints mode has no real MANO mesh; hand_mesh_l2_mm is unavailable and world hand videos show 21 joint points.
Object metrics are GT passthrough in the direct_joints eval path and are not learned object performance.
With n_max=1 and single-hand cam836 windows, detection is structurally easier than multi-slot DETR matching.
Global gamma/orientation decomposition is unavailable because this checkpoint does not predict MANO gamma/phi/theta.
